evidence.target_passage: Doris Miller was acknowledged in the USS West Virginia Action Report, individually, along with other brave personnel for having carried out every order promptly and enthusiastically, even when it meant danger to themselves. They did not attempt to abandon the bridge until ordered to do so . It wasn’t until March of 1942, at the behest of the NAACP, that the Navy formally recognized Miller’s heroism
